title: About Us - BaSuka Energy
metaDescription: BaSuka (meaning 'women's home' in Mooré) builds Burkina Faso's sovereign energy future: 130 MW of new generation capacity plus a smart, women-led electricity network powered by swappable SIRA™ batteries.

sections.eyebrow: Who We Are | Advanced Electricity Infrastructure
sections.heading: About Us
sections.body: BaSuka (meaning 'women's home' in Mooré) is a women-led energy and infrastructure company powering Burkina Faso's sovereign energy future. We start with a generation-first foundation — four thermal power plants delivering 130 MW of new dispatchable capacity — then extend through smart, swappable SIRA™ batteries that power electric mobility, businesses, and homes. Led by Carolyn Wright, our women-managed infrastructure is built specifically for the rugged Sahel environment.

sections.heading: A Sovereign Energy Future for Burkina Faso
sections.body: BaSuka (meaning 'women's home' in Mooré) is a women-led energy and infrastructure company. Our generation-first strategy delivers 130 MW of new dispatchable capacity through four thermal power plants — strengthening grid reliability and unlocking industry, mining, and agro-processing — then extends through smart, swappable SIRA™ batteries that power mobility, businesses, and homes. Led by Carolyn Wright, our women-managed infrastructure is built for the Sahel.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.body: BaSuka Energy delivers reliable, affordable electricity across Burkina Faso and West Africa — beginning with a generation-first foundation of 130 MW of new dispatchable capacity, then extending through smart, portable, swappable batteries that power electric mobility, businesses, and homes.

sections.eyebrow: Our Vision | A Sovereign Energy Future
sections.heading: Our Vision
sections.body: BaSuka Energy will build an integrated, customer-driven energy platform that supports energy sovereignty, industrialization, and inclusive growth — delivering reliable power for the national grid and clean, smart electricity services where grid access fails.

items.title: Accessible → Women-Led Infrastructure
items.body: Managed by certified Yennenga Warriors to build deep community trust and ensure operational excellence. We provide affordable electricity via pay-per-swap SIRA™ access.

items.title: Reliable → Smart Electricity Network
items.body: 99%+ uptime where national grids fail. Our network uses SIRA™ batteries optimized by IoT and solar-first generation to power mobility, businesses, and homes.

items.title: Renewable → Solar-First Stations
items.body: Grid-independent Swap & Glow™ stations running on clean solar power. We advance the transition to clean energy while ensuring a sustainable second-life strategy for all batteries.

items.title: Professional → The 'Yennenga' Legacy
items.body: Rooted in the spirit of Burkina Faso's legendary warrior-princess. We drive local economic growth by empowering women as professional infrastructure leaders through the BaSuka Academy.

items.title: BaSuka Academy
items.body: Professional training for the women who run our stations.

items.title: Partnership
items.body: Build Africa's clean-energy infrastructure with us.

items.title: Impact
items.body: IoT-verified impact data, ready for your ESG portfolio.

sections.heading: We are seeking infrastructure funds, fuel and technology partners, engineering firms, and public-sector allies to build Burkina Faso's energy foundation
sections.body: BaSuka Energy is more than a mobility provider; we are a data-driven infrastructure platform. Our generation-first foundation delivers 130 MW of new dispatchable capacity for the national grid and industry, while our SIRA™ smart batteries provide real-time, blockchain-ready metrics on energy throughput and carbon displacement — ensuring your ESG investments deliver measurable, high-fidelity results in the Sahel.
